dict.string: LaptopBench QC accesses the built-in or external camera to verify video quality and frame rate during laptop diagnostics.
LaptopBench QC accesses the microphone to measure audio input levels and perform a record/playback check during laptop diagnostics.
LaptopBench QC optionally monitors keyboard events so special keys can be verified during the interactive keyboard diagnostic.
LaptopBench QC inspects Bluetooth radio status and paired devices during wireless hardware diagnostics.
LaptopBench QC pings your local gateway to measure Wi-Fi/Ethernet link stability and packet loss.
